notes.title: Hot Fix
notes.notes:
Hello players! With this update, we’ve fixed the major issues you reported and made your gameplay experience more stable. You can see the applied fixes below:

1. Showroom and Vehicle Management
Issue: When you deleted a showroom while it still contained a vehicle, that vehicle would disappear as well.

Fix: Deleting a showroom now only removes the showroom object; vehicles stored inside remain safe in your depot.

2. PSO TRACE Mouse Stuttering
Issue: Mouse movements would stutter while playing in PSO TRACE mode.

Fix: Optimized the interaction between PSO TRACE and the mouse; mouse movements are now smooth.

3. Office, Caravan, and House Add-On Errors
Issue: Certain add-ons for offices, caravans, or houses (for example, changing the house color) were producing errors.

Fix: Reviewed all office/caravan/house add-ons; color settings and other customizations now display correctly.

4. Car Auction Error Trigger
Issue: In the “Car Auction” screen, clicking on a buyer would trigger an error if there were vehicles in your depot.

Fix: Improved the auction entry logic to check for vehicles properly; no errors now occur even when you have cars stored.

5. Saved Game (Save) File Errors
Issue 5.1: When loading save files from before a map change, the game would throw an error and fail to start.

Fix: Added a patch that detects old map formats and applies the necessary conversion. Save files from before the map change now load without issues.

Issue 5.2: Players with older-version save files encountered errors when opening the game.

Fix: Restored full backward compatibility for all previous-version save files. Older saves load properly so you can continue your progress seamlessly.

6. Drag Race Transition Animation Error
Issue: Transitioning to the “Drag Race” screen would trigger an error during the money-text animation.

Fix: Reworked the money animation code; transitioning into a Drag Race now plays the animation smoothly without errors.

Note: All of the above fixes have been thoroughly tested based on your feedback. If you encounter any other issues or have suggestions, please let us know. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: New Update : Improvements
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/6654d2398145e4f5124a8e78ac4f5acf17337df2.gif[/img]

[h3]1. Game Launches Faster[/h3]

In the past, when you first started the game, all vehicle data would load onto your computer at once. This often caused long wait times. Now, we load each car only when you actually need it.

How does this help? The loading time is reduced when you enter the game. Vehicles appear much faster when you browse the menu or switch to a new map.

[h3]2. Smaller Updates When You Have Internet Connection[/h3]

If there’s an update on Steam, instead of downloading the entire vehicle pack again, we only download the small pieces that have changed.

How does this help? Ongoing updates take up less space and download more quickly. When we add a new car or fix visuals on a model, the update size stays small, so the download time is shorter.

[h3]3. Uses Less Memory (RAM) on Your Computer[/h3]

Because not all cars are loaded into memory at the same time, your computer can run more smoothly while you play.

How does this help? If you play for a long time or change maps, you’re less likely to experience stuttering or lag. This makes the overall experience more fluid and enjoyable.

[h3]4. We Can Add New Cars Instantly[/h3]

When our development team creates new cars, new skins, or extra add-ons, those items become available automatically as soon as you update the game. This means:

You can use new vehicles without needing to download a massive file.

If we only change a few models, only those model files get updated.

notes.title: DevLog 6# Car For Sale 2023 Full Access Announcement! 🔥🔥

[h1]Car For Sale 2023 Full Access Announcement! 🎉🎉 [/h1]

Hello Dear Players,

Today, we are proud and excited to announce that Car For Sale Simulator 2023 will soon be entering full access! Thanks to the overwhelming support and valuable feedback you have provided during the early access phase, we have made the game more comprehensive and enjoyable. In this full version, we have added many new features and improvements to enrich your gaming experience. Let’s take a closer look at the exciting updates this major release brings. 👀

[previewyoutube=rZluji2bBGE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]🌍 New Map – A Whole New World Awaiting Exploration![/h2]

We have added a new map to the game. Along with graphic optimizations, this map is now more extensive. The models of all interactive areas in this new map have been redesigned to be more realistic and engaging.

[h3]Palma Town 🌴[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/f1f9c53856008d57530d0dc37c76dfa79513882c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/52551fdbc08db5440675995b3c7dd65d41e20cba.jpg[/img]

We’ve made significant improvements to the user interface and experience to make the game more enjoyable. All game panels have been redesigned to be more organized and user-friendly, making it easier for you to find what you're looking for and perform your tasks more smoothly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/e3e285635cd4cad0e56fafdb6a0963584de6fb53.gif[/img]

[h3]Storage System[/h3]

With Red Tow Service, you can now easily move your vehicle to storage. With this new feature, Red Tow Service will come to your aid when you have a problem with a vehicle or just want to tow it to storage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/49899090ac69e0a620f60887d0a3f69504396969.png[/img]

[h3]New Car Showroom[/h3]

With each car carefully selected and in perfect condition, take your driving experience to the next level!

[b]Palma’s Deluxe Cars[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/147e58a2bedf8dc60c8a8280cbcf9004fe97a8f3.jpg[/img]

[b]Aoudi RR[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/7e1998d4cf4b1532b31b995dce83d83ad0a396c8.jpg[/img]

[b]Porch 930[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/eb2b76dc8577e848d8da3385860d1ed57b681b71.png[/img]

[h3]The Living City[/h3]

With the Living City update, streets are no longer just roads; they are a vibrant world full of people, where you can feel life in every moment! With people walking on the sidewalks, lively traffic flow and street vendors, every corner of the city is full of interaction. There's so much to discover in this new world, and we can't wait as much as you can.

[b]• Traffic and Pedestrian System[/b]

We’ve optimized the traffic and pedestrian system! The streets are now busier, and the traffic flow is smoother. With this new update, city life will be more dynamic and vibrant than ever. Crowded sidewalks and a better-balanced traffic flow will make the atmosphere of the game even more immersive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/44138a000bdab6ac2daedfc9f8ea2a0f5c111100.jpg[/img]

[b]• Dynamic Environment System[/b]

The environment is now more dynamic and interactive. You’ll experience a lively atmosphere filled with street vendors, people chatting, and individuals exercising. This update focuses on enhancing the emotional and experiential aspects, helping players feel more immersed in a realistic and vibrant world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/f08823505de729cdb25009b921742b59007b479d.jpg[/img]

[b]• Movable Objects[/b]

Do you love the sea? We are now making sea voyages a part of your game! With our new update, you’ll be able to travel by boat with your car.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/98332f0f4d987e95b6f55677f2a87f7b895b8406.jpg[/img]


[h2] 🔧 Performance Improvements and Technical Updates – Smoother, More Enjoyable Experience![/h2]

We’ve made a comprehensive technical update to further improve the game’s performance. With graphic optimizations, bug fixes, and improvements that make the overall game flow smoother, we’ve ensured that you won’t encounter any issues while enjoying Car For Sale Simulator 2023. Now you can play the game more stably and seamlessly, focusing on becoming the best car dealer!

[h2] 🔊 Enhanced Sound Experience – Feel It, Don’t Just Play It![/h2]

To enrich the atmosphere of the game, the sound system has been completely overhauled. Now, everything from engine sounds to ambient noises, customer dialogues to business transactions, is much more realistic and impactful. The renewed sound effects will immerse you in the game, strengthening the bond you have with the vehicles. Every car engine’s roar, every deal with a customer, every profit after a sale will echo in your ears, letting you experience the thrill of being a true car dealer.

[h2]🏆 New Achievements – It’s Time to Show Your Skills![/h2]

With the full version, new achievements have been added to challenge your skills and strategic thinking. These achievements will be one of the most rewarding aspects of playing the game. Every achievement will show how far you’ve progressed in the world of car trading and how skilled a dealer you’ve become. These accomplishments will deepen your connection to the game, giving you the pride of reaching your next big goal at every step.

[h2]✨ New Content and Continuous Development – The Adventure is Just Beginning![/h2]

Along with all these new features included in the full version, we are constantly working on new content and updates for you. Car For Sale Simulator 2023 will continue to expand in the future with new maps, sounds, cars, and much more. We are thrilled to have you alongside us on this exciting journey!

We invite you to play Car For Sale Simulator 2023 in its full version and enjoy the best car trading experience. Don’t wait any longer to test your skills and strategies in the trade world! Thank you for being part of our journey.

Get your car ready now, continue exploring new maps, earning new achievements, and rising to the top of the trading world!

notes.title: Devlog # 3 & Midweek Deal
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/d0a7ae7dee3def131826d5eb1b069e648ff44912.png[/img]

Dear Players,

We have exciting news for you today! "Car For Sale Simulator 2023" is now available on Steam's Midweek Deal event with a 20% discount. Don't miss this opportunity to experience your dream car trading adventure at a more affordable price!

[h2][b]Upcoming New Office System
[/b][/h2]

The time has come to express yourself and unleash your creativity! We have an exciting development to announce to our valued players. In our CFS23 game, you will be able to design your office just the way you want it. Do you envision a single-story office or a towering five-story one? The choice is entirely yours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/8a00cdb04382978d61260a20d242c0db2c86ca87.gif[/img]

And it's not just about the interior design of the office, but also the exterior that will reflect your freedom. In short, our game will provide you with a complete opportunity to showcase your creativity. Of course, if you want to place your vehicles in your office, you can use the elevator system to transport them to the desired floor. Similarly, constructing stairs for people will be your responsibility. You'll need to pay specific fees for different floors and structures, so it's a good idea to have your money ready in advance! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/c8253b3b843ebadad53b7f292e927c540b21e77f.gif[/img]

While offering such a free experience, we might encounter unexpected issues. As long as you report any potential errors or difficulties to us, we are here to swiftly resolve them. While you enjoy the game, our technical team will work behind the scenes to address any issues.

We're excited to join the growing CFS23 family, fueled by your support and feedback, and to see your creative ideas reflected in our game.

[h2][b]New UI Designs
[/b][/h2]
We have completely overhauled our UI designs. We'll soon share these exciting changes with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/fd5cb98035c300bf77d3509686d7d1b1b29e3856.jpg[/img]

As a team, we've put in significant effort to make the user interface (UI) of the game more functional, aesthetic, and user-friendly. With this design update, our goal is to enrich and streamline players' in-game experience. Here are some highlights:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/5d1d57514922a6aa7ff0bf92c15c7af8a38197b1.jpg[/img]

New Menu Design: In-game menus are now more intuitive and easy to understand. From the main menu to trade options, we're providing a smoother navigation experience at every step.

Improved UI Elements: We've added new UI elements for viewing your car collection, making purchases, performing repairs, and more. You'll be able to complete every step more comfortably and quickly.

Color and Theme Harmonization: Our new designs incorporate color palettes and theme elements that harmonize with the game's overall thematic structure. This aims to create a more consistent atmosphere in the game.

[h2][b]Coming Soon: Innovative Junkyard System and Realistic Repair Experience!
[/b][/h2]
We're deepening your gameplay experience with the brand-new junkyard system we'll be adding to the game soon. This system will offer you the chance to engage in a more immersive car salvage and repair adventure.

[b]Junkyard: A Realistic Vehicle Salvage Adventure
[/b]
With the junkyard system, our goal is to provide players with a realistic car salvage and repair adventure. You'll buy real salvage vehicles from the junkyard and bring them back to life. However, a word of caution: we don't recommend buying every salvage vehicle! Some vehicles might have hard-to-find parts, requiring strategic thinking on your part.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/b00fa69515639ebb7cbcdc7d35fbba3965fb5fc7.png[/img]

[b]Find Parts, Repair, and Get Back on the Road
[/b]
Each salvage vehicle will have its unique set of parts. The process of repairing a car will begin once you've found the essential parts. Once these parts are correctly installed, the vehicle will become operational. But the process doesn't end there! Your vehicle might not be in the desired condition yet. You'll need to find other parts to complete your car. This is designed to offer a true car mechanic experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/5212bf01305747e2e6175dda01ce193b3ba48454.png[/img]

[b]A Strategic and Skillful Experience
[/b]
In this new system, it won't just be about finding parts; you'll also need to carefully consider which vehicles to choose. Some salvage vehicles might be easier to repair, while finding the necessary parts for others could be quite challenging. As a result, we recommend adopting a strategic approach when deciding which vehicles to purchase.

[h2][b]CFS23 Mobile
[/b][/h2]
There are fake versions of our game on the current mobile market, and these games are not ours. Despite our efforts to address this, we haven't been able to prevent it. We advise against playing these games as if they were our own.

Taking into account our players' feedback, we're making dedicated efforts to bring our game to the mobile platform. The mobile version will include many of the beloved and appreciated features from Steam, along with new features tailored for the mobile gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/38302b77e76965a08fcbfa1f98af01dc09c71dde.png[/img]

[h3]Key Features of the Mobile Version:
[/h3]
[b]Daily Cash Rewards: [/b]When you log in daily and complete specific tasks, you'll earn daily cash rewards. These rewards will help you expand your business and grow your collection.

[b]Car Crates:[/b] The mobile version will offer special crates containing different cars. By opening these crates, you can add rare and unique vehicles to your collection.

[b]Racing Events: [/b]You can participate in drag, drift, and circuit races with the cars you've purchased. Compete against opponents, prove your skills and speed, and earn rewards.

[b]Repair and Customization:[/b] You can repair, refurbish, and customize your cars. This way, you can sell them at higher prices.

[b]Auction System:[/b] Similar to the current Steam version, you can organize auctions and bid on other players' cars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/608f11c558e6f7dc857408de7cde10fe41e961d7.png[/img]

We'll share more details about the mobile version of the game with you, so stay tuned! Additionally, we value your feedback throughout the development process. We'll do our best to provide you with the best possible experience.

[h2][b]New Game Announcement
[/b][/h2]
Following our game "Car For Sale Simulator 2023," we're excited to introduce a new experience named "Gym Simulator 24." This game brings together sports and simulation enthusiasts, offering you the opportunity to manage and develop your own gym. This game allows you to showcase both your sports and business management skills, promising a unique experience.

"Gym Simulator 24" will await you with its rich content, detailed graphics, and impressive gameplay. You'll have the chance to manage every aspect, from designing your gym and selecting equipment to creating training programs and handling customer relations. We can't wait for you to experience this exciting adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/f5c632044f6527d455ca5f990ad0fb9938e72eaf.gif[/img]


[b]We are making significant improvements to the scrapyard system. In a nutshell, we will now have the ability to purchase scrap vehicles. However, our goal is not just to repair and sell these vehicles in a normal way, but to do something different.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/b00fa69515639ebb7cbcdc7d35fbba3965fb5fc7.png[/img]
[u]Note: These updates have not been implemented yet. We wanted to provide information about upcoming updates.[/u]

Here's how it works: In the scrapyard, you inspect and purchase damaged vehicles. However, since these vehicles are heavily damaged, they are currently unusable and require specific parts to function. You have the chance to find these parts in the scrapyard or buy them from someone who sells car parts. Each vehicle will have its own unique parts, so you'll need to find the parts specific to the brand of the vehicle you purchased. Once you have completed the parts, you can start using the vehicle, but it will still require repairs, so it will only move very slowly and be able to go to the repair shop. After taking the car to the repair shop, the mechanic will ask you for specific parts again, and once you provide them, your vehicle will be repaired. Then, if you wish, you can perform painting or cleaning procedures.


Along with this system, an inventory system is also being introduced into the game. You will be able to see the parts you collect or purchase in the inventory.

Thank you.

notes.title: Upcoming Major Updates
notes.notes:

Hello, driving enthusiasts!
We have some exciting news for you!

We want to share our roadmap with you, which includes the major updates we have planned based on the feedback we have received from you.

The dates for these major updates are not set in stone, and in addition to these updates, continuous updates will continue to be released.

The multiplayer mode will allow you to fully enjoy your game. You can trade with other players, auction or bid on cars for sale, and try different strategies to earn extra income in the game. At the same time, you can expand your collection by purchasing vehicles offered by other players.

notes.title: Devlog #2 And Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/55e822c50adb5fd8f3c29282857be216085add3e.png[/img]

[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

First of all, we invite everyone to our Discord channel, where we share screenshots and information about the development of the game. And we can also just chat there!

[b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/bwDJjqPQMb


[b][h1]Updates[/h1][/b]
[b][h2]New Cars[/h2][/b]
In the last demo version, 28 cars were available. We understand that this amount will not be enough, so we continue to add new models in the development process. Most of the cars added will be European.

After the game is released in early access, you will be able to offer the car you are interested in to add to the game in our Discord channel! It is quite possible that your favorite car will be added with subsequent updates of early access.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/f81f97c9bac2630f1df90dbc77b2d0b9455bc073.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/8b057dd82514ed485f56009e3a457bead1350cb5.png[/img]

[b][h2]Car Tuning[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/b595659c2563120fa1dbebda8f81fc38ddd8c4c8.jpg[/img]
You can tune your car by contacting a tuning workshop.

We have divided tuning into 3 main areas: regular, drift and racing.

[b]Normal kit:[/b] has standard performance, which is available in the factory version of the car.
[b]Drift kit:[/b] specially selected components for a drift car
[b]Racing Kit:[/b] increases the power of your car, providing high acceleration speed.

In addition, you can install ABS, ESP, TCS systems in your car; install turbocharging and a NoS system.

You can adjust the front and rear suspension of the car and change the color of the headlights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/723acc11eeafa5447cdb0730d27c98d3689b160b.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Gas Station [/h2][/b]
You will need to refuel your cars. You can do it at the gas station. Be careful, if you run out of gas and you stay on the road, you will have to pay for evacuation!
You can see the amount of gasoline in the tank when buying a car, but for this you will need to study the corresponding ability of the skill tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/e59792afb83ec172710560d9c692a3927782efe6.png[/img]

[b][h1]Release Date [/h1][/b]
Yes, let's come to the last question :)
We decided to slightly shift the release date to provide a better and more content-filled product. During the development process, we decided to add new mechanics that we had not previously planned :)
[b] On May 18, 2023 [/b]Car For Sale Simulator 2023 goes into early access.
Thanks

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/dd62fed0fd419563444beb9bf2701240b947e711.png[/img]

[b]Greetings Everyone,[/b]

First of all, we share the images and information we share here on our discord server beforehand. We can come, see and chat.

Discord : https://discord.gg/bwDJjqPQMb

[h2][b]Latest Status;[/b][/h2]

First of all, thank you very much for your great interest in the game. It gives us great motivation.
We listen to your problems as much as we can and update the game.

We've expanded to a larger audience than we expected, and as a result, we've decided to drastically change the game.We've added major updates to the game [b]while keeping the game's theme.[/b]
We are working hard for early access, we are trying to make a game that is both error-free and you can play for a longer time.

We started the updates after the demo, but as you know, there was a big earthquake in our country. (Turkiye/Kahramanmaras)
We had to put aside our work because of the earthquake.
Unfortunately, life in our country has come to a standstill and the motivation of all our people has dropped to a great extent.
We stopped 1 week of development. Now we continue with much better motivation.

[b][h2]UPDATES[/h2][/b]

We have received a lot of questions so far, you wondered what we were doing. We wanted to give you some news before it goes into Early Access.

We've updated our map for early access. Now we have a more beautiful city. Besides, our graphics are much better quality now.
We have updated our bar or other venues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/90bf47c747bd0f76b4d179367e4fe506d252d58b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/e628c9fbb90fad7ed0fe50caf23bde0cdc3746d6.jpg[/img]

Of course we had to review our cars and we tried to add better quality vehicles and driving system as much as we could.
We have not only increased the vehicle quality, but also added new systems to the vehicles. Signals, more beautiful light systems, hand etc.
We have even better things in mind, but we'll make these updates once our game hits  early access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/99894ef1276c4551b2bd606035539bc8dcde70eb.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/d86f8cd651e9c48d6df66a12fc7c750310df2170.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/a3f9f9ef50fd348cb7268cf03454f955fafacd9a.jpg[/img]

As you remember, our office was a little empty, and we were aware of this. We added a decoration system to our office and homes. So that it is more beautiful and as you like.We let you edit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/fed6f49e5cb28ce59e7127475dce97e79a8130bb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/ab7f8f9f1bc65ebc72a8cdca7196b4f584b819a1.jpg[/img]

We have added an car expert system to the game. Now, the vehicle dealers in front of us can be emotional and they can lie to us.
We can learn to car damaged parts look at the car expert raport.

Finally, for this update note, we'd like to show you the Junkyard system. There is now a junkyard near our office. You will be able to collect scrap from the junkyard.
You can also break the vehicles in the junkyard and collect the scraps that come out of it. You will be able to sell the scraps you collect and earn money.
Bigger updates are coming for the junkyard system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/0e448e8a39aea791659d74856806abb81f931078.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/e0f86c63a48beb0220c6f13073e19ae0e576ef2d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/e4a1b239ca650b439b6b4c19a4bfca94efebbdfe.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]When will the game be released ?[/b][/h3]
We said Q1 for Early Access, but for the reason we mentioned above and to make a much better game, we moved our game's release time to a later date.
We want to release our game immediately and we are working as fast as we can.

notes.title: Demo v0.4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/b7985483cb33cdd33f8da5be3e3876fd50f47fcf.png[/img]

[b][h1]Bug fixes:[/h1][/b]
Fixed a problem with damage to the car when you get into it.
Fixed the behavior of the camera while driving.
The effect of intoxication is added when driving a car.
Fixed the sound of the door opening when entering the car.
Fixed a bug that caused the functions of some cars to not turn on/off.
Fixed the error of passing through walls and windows at the car wash.
Fixed a bug where clicking the "Pay All" button on the bill payment panel played the sound of withdrawing money, even if there are no bills.
Fixed a bug where the game freezes when exiting the game to the main menu.
Fixed a bug that caused the character to recline if he approached the wheels during vehicle repairs.

[b][h1]Updates:[/h1][/b]
The demo version now lasts 3 game days.
Actions that required "holding" the key are now performed by "pressing" the key. Except for opening/closing car doors/trunks.
The inscription "Daily customers" in the upper left corner has been removed.
Fixed translation errors into English.
French translation errors have been fixed.
Turkish translation errors have been fixed.

[b][h1]Innovations:[/h1][/b]
Now, when evening comes, the night illumination of buildings turns on.

notes.title: Early Access Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/4e07e95174719475fac7c13a82a1c75f524da207.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/09b4f0b3c99461474aa555098348f3013a3b0749.png[/img]

[b]Whether the vehicles are damaged or not plays an important role in car sales.Sellers may lie to you and it's your decision whether or not to trust them.In exchange for a certain amount in a vehicle you suspect you can find out the actual damage status and information by putting the vehicle under appraisal.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/b85b6c247ce896f688dc8d07e8903a70bbbb8289.png[/img]

[b]You can go to the car junkyard and get a job to provide you with additional income. You can collect and sell metal by smashing cars. You can also find obsolete or unused vehicles from the junkyard. You will have the opportunity to buy the vehicle from the scrap dealer, repair it and sell it.
In addition, you will have the chance to find the stolen parts of your cars from here.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/478ba02be57be691b054e67ee89cb2058a6e69d1.png[/img]

[b]You can steal a car by stealing illegally. But here you should be very careful. If you are caught by the police, you can impose heavy fines and confiscate your existing vehicles and shop.But if you manage to steal a car and try to sell it in your dealership through legal means, you risk getting caught by the police. You can make a net profit by selling your car with the black market
[/b]
